architects-guild.abilityText: When you gain a card, you may spend 2 Favors to gain a cheaper non-Victory card.

band-of-nomads.abilityText: When you gain a card costing $3 or more, you may spend a Favor, for +1 Card, or +1 Action, or +1 Buy.

cave-dwellers.abilityText: At the start of your turn, you may spend a Favor, to discard a card then draw a card. Repeat as desired.

circle-of-witches.abilityText: After playing a Liaison, you may spend 3 Favors to have each other player gain a Curse.

city-state.abilityText: When you gain an Action card during your turn, you may spend 2 Favors to play it.

coastal-haven.abilityText: When discarding your hand in Clean-up, you may spend any number of Favors to keep that many cards in hand for next turn (you still draw 5).

crafters-guild.abilityText: At the start of your turn, you may spend 2 Favors to gain a card costing up to $4 onto your deck.

desert-guides.abilityText: At the start of your turn, you may spend a Favor to discard your hand and draw 5 cards. Repeat as desired.

family-of-inventors.abilityText: At the start of your Buy phase, you may put a Favor token you have on a non-Victory Supply pile. Cards cost $1 less per Favor token on their piles.

fellowship-of-scribes.abilityText: After playing an Action, if you have 4 or fewer cards in hand, you may spend a Favor for +1 Card.

forest-dwellers.abilityText: At the start of your turn, you may spend a Favor to look at the top 3 cards of your deck, discard any number and put the rest back in any order.

gang-of-pickpockets.abilityText: At the start of your turn, discard down to 4 cards in hand unless you spend a Favor.

island-folk.abilityText: At the end of your turn, you may spend 5 Favors to take an extra turn after this one (but not a 3rd turn in a row).

league-of-bankers.abilityText: At the start of your Buy phase, +$1 per 4 Favors you have (round down).

league-of-shopkeepers.abilityText: After playing a Liaison, if you have 5 or more Favors, +$1, and if 10 or more, +1 Action and +1 Buy.

market-towns.abilityText: At the start of your Buy phase, you may spend a Favor to play an Action card from your hand. Repeat as desired.

mountain-folk.abilityText: At the start of your turn, you may spend 5 Favors for +3 Cards.

order-of-astrologers.abilityText: When shuffling, you may pick one card per Favor you spend to go on top.

order-of-masons.abilityText: When shuffling, you may pick up to 2 cards per Favor you spend to put into your discard pile.

peaceful-cult.abilityText: At the start of your Buy phase, you may spend any number of Favors to trash that many cards from your hand.

plateau-shepherds.abilityText: When scoring, pair up your Favors with cards you have costing $2, for 2VP per pair.

trappers-lodge.abilityText: When you gain a card, you may spend a Favor to put it onto your deck.

woodworkers-guild.abilityText: At the start of your Buy phase, you may spend a Favor to trash an Action card from your hand. If you did, gain an Action card.
